items.title: Why Yield Optimization Is the Only Travel AI Story That Matters Right Now
items.summary: Mia Morisset knows which travel AI bets will hold: yield optimization, corporate travel reinvention, and distribution moats built on data. She is equally clear on where capital is leaking. Both arguments are worth hearing before the market makes them for you.

items.title: Google Names Hotels as Next Vertical for Agentic Shopping
items.summary: Google has been building toward agentic hotel booking in plain sight. Now it's said so out loud.

items.title: Uber CEO: Is AI Really Improving People’s Lives?
items.summary: There's an AI backlash coming, for sure.

items.title: Expedia CEO Ariane Gorin on What Companies Get Wrong About AI Chatbots
items.summary: Roamie became a victim of test-and learn. Expedia found that a chatbot that's an end-to end solution isn't practical for now — but it might be in the future.

items.title: Expedia Pushes Meta, Uber, and Clear Partnerships to Own More of the Trip
items.summary: Expedia isn't reinventing the OTA. It's stretching the definition — upstream into inspiration, downstream into day-of-travel — so booking becomes one stop in a longer relationship.

items.title: MakeMyTrip Takes Steps Toward India IPO
items.summary: MakeMyTrip wants to list in India but can't say when. The regulatory groundwork has started, the timeline hasn't. Watch this space... slowly.

items.title: How a Small Hotel Group Is Financing Solar When Federal Tax Credits Are Gone
items.summary: The rollback of U.S. clean energy tax credits has not stopped every hotel from investing in renewables.

items.title: ‘Skip the Visa’: Indian Companies Respond After Modi’s Call to Stay Home
items.summary: Telling the middle class to swap Bali for Kashmir sounds noble. But when a Dehradun flight costs as much as a Colombo holiday, patriotism alone won't fix the math.
